overview.name: Honda Amaze
overview.summary: Honda Amaze price for the base model starts at Rs. 7.69 Lakh and the top model price goes upto Rs. 10.02 Lakh (Avg. ex-showroom). Amaze price for 6 variants is listed below.

user_reviews.title: Excellent Family Car with Great Comfort and Reliability
user_reviews.author: Carwale User
user_reviews.text: I have been driving this car for quite some time, and my overall ownership experience has been very satisfying. It delivers around 16 kmpl mileage, which is good for daily use. The driving comfort is excellent, the cabin is spacious, and the engine feels smooth and refined. The ride quality is comfortable on both city roads and highways. The features are practical, maintenance is reasonable, and the car feels reliable. Overall, it is a perfect family car with a good balance of comfort, performance, and value for money. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a dependable vehicle.

user_reviews.title: Good designs features

user_reviews.text: The Honda Amaze Petrol Manual is a popular compact sedan known for its reliability, comfort, and fuel efficiency. It is powered by a 1.2-litre i-VTEC petrol engine that produces about 90 PS of power and offers smooth performance for both city driving and highway trips. The 5-speed manual gearbox is easy to use and provides a comfortable driving experience, especially for daily commuters

user_reviews.title: Look wise it surely has a good road presence
user_reviews.author: Vinod Surendran
user_reviews.text:
I took a VX CVT around 15 days back. The dealership experience was smooth and professional, Driving was a breeze, much smoother, and had better shocks than the previous one. Honda has indeed improved the safety of the car, now it surely feels sturdy and safe while driving. One could feel the heaviness of the hood and side doors. Look wise it surely has a good road presence. This can get a 5 star rating if send for GNCAP, that is what I feel.
Pro: Good family car. Driving is comfy noise level is less inside
Cons: Yet to complete first service, think the mileage may be around 15 km/l in the city.

user_reviews.title: Honda Amaze, The Perfect Blend of Comfort and Class

The interiors feel premium, and the ride quality is excellent. It’s a reliable, practical sedan that performs best on open roads.

user_reviews.title: It’s an excellent premium family car
user_reviews.author: Santhosh Kumar
user_reviews.text:
Amaze ZX CVT is the new car I bought a month ago. As a global traveler, I have now witnessed Honda’s global quality standards & new design language have been completely adopted in 3rd gen Amaze. Added safety features over the sunroof and refinement on 4 cyl engine is amazing. ADAS was truly giving a luxurious experience and feeling safer with its collision mitigation braking system.

user_reviews.title: Bought the Obsidian Blue ZX CVT version of Amaze
user_reviews.author: Solomon Ranjith
user_reviews.text:
Bought the Obsidian Blue ZX CVT version of Amaze, took the test drive as soon as the vehicle was launched right after 2 days, and booked it immediately, always been an SUV fan but wanted to try a sedan for the first time. I was thoroughly impressed by how smooth and planted the car goes on the road. I checked so many compact SUV'S in the price range but this one a class product, ground clearance is good even after making four adults occupied in the car.

One should take a test drive to understand how much better it is than its rivals. I got the car delivered a few days back. I'm extremely happy with my choice. It's a fantastic car for daily commutes and occasional road trips. I got 7 years of warranty with unlimited kms, which is unmatched with any other car. I upgraded this car from the Etios Liva Diesel manual. There is so much difference in the whole form. 

I would highly recommend the Amaze to anyone looking for a reliable, fuel-efficient, and comfortable car in this segment.

user_reviews.title: Great car in budget
user_reviews.author: Mr MM
user_reviews.text:
I bought a ZX MT obsidian blue colour, last month, driven around 3100km, 
Passengers are very comfortable for long rides too.. If you want an entry-level sedan, go for it. The engine is very refined. AC is great. Very much stable with higher speeds. Headlights are very good indeed. 
Looks are subjective, I love the front look. 

Combined Average mileage I am getting is between 15 and 16, 
On highways I got a highest of 18.3 kmpl. Bumper to bumper, I am getting around 10. 


The cons I can think of right now are that the under-thigh support is not that great (I'm 183), and I bought a cushion from Frido, which cancels that issue. 

So far so good.

My verdict: It is offering what a car can offer within that particular price range. Didn't feel over priced or under powered. They could have come up with better thigh support. 
From inside it looks like a bigger car.

user_reviews.title: Well balanced compact sedan with decent engine
user_reviews.author: Samyakth Jain
user_reviews.text: I got a Honda Amaze VX in 2022. It's been 3 years of riding, and I enjoy the car every time I drive. The dealership gave competitive pricing, and I felt it was a value-for-money with a big boot space for family trips. Rear seat space is also ample, and the car cabin doesn't feel small at all. The engine is not very punchy but offers a decent ride and handling. Also gets auto headlamp, cruise control, keyless entry, armrest and other necessary features. Totally, I'm happy with the product and service.

user_reviews.title: My first dream car
user_reviews.author: Abhijit Latkar
user_reviews.text:
I purchased the new Honda Amaze about a month ago, and after driving it for around 1500 km in mixed conditions, here’s my detailed experience:
 Looks & Style – 4.8/5
The Amaze stands out with its clean and elegant styling. The front looks premium, and the overall design feels modern and well-balanced.
Reason for slight deduction: the rear side lacks some lighting elements, which makes it look a bit plain compared to the front. A slightly enhanced tail-light setup would have made it perfect.


Mileage – 4.0/5
Mileage before the first service has been average but acceptable:

Highway: 16–17 kmpl

City: 8–12 kmpl
Considering it's still before the first major service, there's room for improvement, but it performs decently on long drives.

 Safety – 4.7/5

The Amaze feels secure on the road. The ADAS functions work perfectly, especially in traffic and on highways. It adds a solid confidence boost for daily commuting and weekend trips.

 Power – 4.2/5

Powered by the i-VTEC engine, the car delivers sufficient and smooth power for city traffic and occasional highway runs. It’s not extremely sporty, but it never feels underpowered.
 Comfort – 4.5/5

Ride comfort in the city is impressive with a well-tuned suspension.
However, on highways, the car feels slightly bumpy at higher speeds or on uneven patches.

 Interiors – 4.9/5

The cabin stands out with simple, clean, and classy interiors. The layout is user-friendly, the materials feel good, and the overall ambience is elegant. Hard to find anything to complain about here.

Overall Impression

The Honda Amaze 3G is a stylish, comfortable, and safe compact sedan that performs well for daily use. With refined interiors and reliable Honda engineering, it’s a great buy for those looking for a practical and premium-feeling car.
